thread:
Jules (People Ops): Quick request  can we create a tiny manager paste that covers goal framing, self-review prompts, and a 1-line feedback script? Needs to be easy to copy into calendar notes.
Elena R: Yes please. Also include a short example sentence for ICs to lift into self-reviews.
Samir V: Add a checkbox line for benefits-eligible mentoring time (helps managers track development hours).
Harper M: Suggest a one-line prompt that ties work to customer outcome + compliance (for teams with regulated data).
Jules (People Ops): Draft below  trying to keep each goal block <=6 lines.
Jules (People Ops): ```
MANAGER PRE-CHECK (30s): aligned? metric? blocker owner? dev hours?
Goal (one line): "Improve X so Y customers see Z% better response time"
Why (one line): customer or risk reduction impact + compliance note if relevant
Sprint commits: 2 actions (owner + ETA) | Mentoring: 1h/mo checkbox
Confidence: 1-5 | Blockers/deps: owner + ETA
Self-review prompt (IC): "What I shipped, the signal it created, and what I'd do differently"
Feedback script: Evidence -> Impact -> Next step (ex: "When you did X I saw Y; it caused Z. Try A next time.")
Calibration note (private): Outcome / Signals / Leveling suggestion
```
Elena R: Example self-review sentence: "I launched feature X, observed a 12% latency reduction in prod traces, would add stronger end-to-end tests next time."
Samir V: Love the mentoring checkbox. Helps during development budgeting.
Harper M: Adding the compliance tag is useful for Private deployment teams.
CoachBot: Tip: paste the self-review prompt into the Slack thread when you request peer feedback to get structured replies.
Jules (People Ops): I'll finalize and post in the performance kickoff doc. Pilot volunteers? :raised_hands:
